summary: Backend-only test for Pupu playlist system. Verified DB CRUD against real Supabase pooler (asyncpg, statement_cache_size=0), bot wiring via logs, /api/bot/status, and playback DIAG harness. All 4 pytest tests pass; DIAG shows HTTP-DIRECT/SOUNDCLOUD/YOUTUBE+FB all OK after restart.
critical_code_review_comments: playlist_db.py is clean and small; parameterized queries throughout, transactional save_tracks and remove_track reindex. Good.
list_playlists returns raw asyncpg Records including created_at (datetime) — fine for internal bot use, but if ever surfaced via JSON API, serialize explicitly.
MAX_NAME_LEN=32 is enforced via clean_name; consider also rejecting empty names after strip (currently a name of only spaces becomes '' and can be created).
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST playlists ('mytest', 'second') for user 999999999998 during test run. All rows removed in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_playlist_db.py covers ensure_schema, create/list/get/add/save/remove/delete + FK cascade + unique constraint checks + bot status endpoint. Run with: python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_playlist_db.py -v -o addopts=''. Do not pass -n auto because async fixtures + xdist loadscope caused issues here. Bot logs at /var/log/supervisor/pupu_bot.err.log show 'Playlist DB connected (Supabase Postgres)', 'Synced 17 slash commands', 'Pupu online', and DIAG all-OK after latest restart.
